visual_strategy.rendering_note: PDF screenshot requests were attempted for the arXiv PDF but failed with a cache-miss error. The arXiv HTML representation and parsed PDF text supplied captions, rows, equations, and page-linked text, so every listed figure and table was reconciled as a structured block without pretending that page-image review succeeded.

coverage_decision: Cover all main-text sections, Figures 1-6, Tables 1-6, and methodologically important appendix material including Figure 7 and Tables 7-10. Exclude bibliography prose from SEA condensation after separate reference extraction.
omissions: Reference entries are stored separately in 2608.16554v1-references.md rather than repeated in the SEA narrative.

Appendix D is listed in the source structure, but the arXiv HTML representation exposes the heading without recoverable example text; the scoring system itself is covered from Appendix E.2 and Table 9.
source_consistency_findings: The abstract and MPB diagnostics describe six perturbation types. Table 8 in the arXiv HTML representation contains seven named construction-method rows because it includes both qualifier removal and qualifier disruption. The appraisal flags this rather than choosing one count.
